references.text: Moses warns against taking silver and gold from idols, calling them detestable things that must be completely destroyed
The prohibition against making gods of silver and gold alongside the Lord
Isaiah describes the worthlessness of idols—those who make them will be put to shame
Description of how idol images are made of wood and metal by craftsmen
Ezekiel describes Israel's idol worship in Egypt with their abominations
The psalmist describes the nations' gods as silver and gold, works of human hands
Idol images of silver and gold that are human-made and lifeless
Jeremiah describes how idols are made of wood and adorned with silver and gold
Habakkuk condemns carved images and cast idols of gold and silver
The Revelation of John describes people who worship idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
